pipeline_result.response: Gualdo Tadino Cathedral, a Roman Catholic cathedral in Gualdo Tadino, region of Umbria, Italy.
retrieved_context: Gualdo Tadino Cathedral: Gualdo Tadino Cathedral (Italian: "Duomo di Gualdo Tadino; Basilica Cattedrale di San Benedetto" ) is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Gualdo Tadino in Umbria, Italy, dedicated to Saint Benedict of Nursia.  Formerly a Benedictine abbey church, it became a cathedral in 1915, and is now a co-cathedral in the diocese of Assisi-Nocera Umbra-Gualdo Tadino.

Benedict of Nursia: Benedict of Nursia (Latin: "Benedictus de Nursia" ; Italian: "Benedetto da Norcia" ; Vulgar Latin: "*Benedecto"; Gothic: "𐌱𐌴𐌽𐌴𐌳𐌹𐌺𐍄, Benedikt" ; 2 March 480 – 543 or 547 AD) is a Christian saint, who is venerated in the Eastern Orthodox Churches, the Catholic Church, the Oriental Orthodox Churchese Anglican Communion and Old Catholic Churches. He is a patron saint of Europe.

San Francesco, Gualdo Tadino: San Francesco is a Gothic-style, Roman Catholic church located in Piazza Martiri della Libertà of Gualdo Tadino, region of Umbria, Italy.  It is located opposite to the Cathedral of Gualdo Tadino.
